name: Joshua Sands
bio: A Representative from New York; born in Cow Neck (now Sands Point), Queens County, Long Island, N.Y., October 12, 1757; received a limited schooling; served in the Revolutionary War, captain; engaged in mercantile pursuits; member of the New York state senate, 1792-1799; collector of customs at the port of New York, 1797; elected as a Federalist to the Eighth Congress (March 4, 1803-March 3, 1805); was not a candidate for renomination in 1804; president of the board of trustees of the village of Brooklyn, N.Y., in 1824; elected as an Adams candidate to the Nineteenth Congress (March 4, 1825-March 3, 1827); died on September 13, 1835, in Brooklyn, N.Y.; interment in St. Paul's Church Cemetery, Eastchester, N.Y.; reinterment in Greenwood Cemetery, Brooklyn, N.Y., in 1852.
